regions.region: page 1 title, authors, article metadata, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: Verified the full article title and the current Pd/chiral-PTC stereoconvergent allenylic alkylation class. The graphical abstract reports 29 successful examples and up to 95:5 dr/98% ee; it is an aggregate summary and not an additional experimental run.

regions.region: page 1 two-column introduction and cited 1,3-nonadjacent stereocontrol discussion
regions.finding: Classified the Mi/Luo, Li/Shao, and Wen/Guo Pd/organo systems as prior literature context. Their arrows are represented as literature examples using Scheme 1 evidence on page 2 and are not promoted to current-paper experiments.

unresolved: Graphical-abstract structures contain generic Ar/R groups and do not supply experiment-specific charges or procedures.
The publisher SI link does not establish workspace SI association.

regions.finding: Inspected the three cited Pd/chiral amine or aldehyde arrows for prior 1,3-nonadjacent stereocontrol and classified each as a literature example rather than a current experiment.

Inspected the Takemoto 2003, Han 2017, and Zi 2023 transition-metal/chiral-PTC arrows. Each is a distinct prior-literature example; the qualitative single/vicinal/remote stereocenter comparison is not an experiment.
Classified the generic Pd/chiral-PTC allenyl-acetate plus oxindole transformation as the current general reaction class. Generic R/Ar groups were not assigned a scope-row yield.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 reaction header and catalyst/ligand/PTC structures
regions.finding: Read the shared 1a/2a charges, [Pd(allyl)Cl]2, ligand/PTC/base/toluene, 0 °C, N2, and 24 h conditions and source labels L1-L5/PTC-1-PTC-6. Complex structures remain source-labeled and unverified.

regions.region: page 2 right Table 1 entries 1-17 and footnotes a-f
regions.finding: Recorded all 17 optimization rows independently with row-specific ligand/PTC/base, isolated yield, dr, ee, NaOH 2.5-equiv footnote, and entry-17 8/16/16 mol% plus 36 h override. Entry 17 is cross-page merged with standard 3aa/Mechanistic Scheme 4 entry 1.

No SI fact or structure was inferred.

regions.finding: Mapped catalyst loading, base stoichiometry, and time discussion to Table 1 entries 14-17; no narrative duplicate was created.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 2 reaction header, product grid 3aa-3an, and footnotes a-e
regions.finding: Recorded thirteen additional allenyl-acetate scope experiments, merged standard 3aa into Table 1 entry 17, and recorded the parenthetical 1.0 mmol 3aa run separately (73%, 91:9 dr, 92% ee). Exact yields/dr/ee, including paired ee values for 3al/3am, were retained.

Mapped every product-specific narrative statement to the Scheme 2 rows. The prose calls the 2-naphthyl and trisubstituted allenyl-acetate substrates 2j/2n although the scheme defines the allenyl-acetate 1-series; the discrepancy is retained in the 3aj/3an records.

regions.region: page 3 Scheme 3 reaction header, product grid 3ba-3qa, and footnotes a-d
regions.finding: Recorded all sixteen oxindole rows independently: fourteen products visible on page 3 plus continuation products 3ma-3qa on page 4, including explicit NR for 3ia and 3ja. Shared charges/conditions and product-specific isolated yield/dr/ee are structured.

unresolved: Scope schemes omit row-specific workups, purifications, masses, and full systematic names.
The 1.0 mmol scale denominator and scaled solvent volume are not stated.
Scheme 2 prose/figure substrate-label discrepancies for 3aj/3an remain unresolved.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left continuation of Scheme 3 discussion
regions.finding: Confirmed 3ma/3na 95:5 dr/98% ee and C6-substituted 3oa-3qa outcomes; these continue the existing Scheme 3 rows rather than defining new prose experiments.

Merged the none/standard row into Table 1 entry 17 and recorded four distinct variations: without L5 (n.d.), without PTC-3 (75%, 72:28, 6% ee), ent-L5 (78%, 86:14, 96% ee), and ent-PTC-3 (85%, 82:18, -96% ee). Negative ee sign is preserved separately from the nonnegative percentage quantity.
Recorded separate (R)-1a and (S)-1a controls, each starting at 93% ee and giving 3aa with 95:5 dr/96% ee at 76% and 72% yield, respectively.
Classified the PTC and Pd cycles as one proposed mechanism with ion pair I, (R)-II/(S)-II, eta1 intermediate III, and one equivalent of water. Proposed intermediates were not treated as preparations.
